                                             ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detachied House) District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 13-J in the area bounded by

West Catalpa Avenue; North Spaulding Avenue; A line 38.56 feet south of and parallel to West Catalpa
Avenue; and the alley next west of and parallel to North Spaulding Avenue.

to those of a RM 4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District


SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.
